To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present SoptSC, a method that infers multiple tasks in single-cell transcriptomics, including cell subpopulations, marker genes, pseudotime, and lineage, in addition to cell communication networks.

we developed a computational method for inferring cell subpopulations, cell lineages, and cell communication networks from single-cell transcriptome data, and that we demonstrated its utility in multiple biological systems, including early development and regeneration.

we developed a novel method, SoptSC, to perform cell clustering, marker gene detection, pseudotime ordering, lineage inference and cell–cell communication network prediction from single-cell transcriptomics, which we applied to three datasets of early embryonic development in C. elegans, epidermal stem cells in Drosophila, and human hematopoietic development.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a novel mathematical method for the inference of single-cell data, which can be used to identify cell lineages and cell-to-cell communication networks, which are important for the development of a cell-based model of complex biological systems.
the mathematical modeling of single-cell transcriptomic data and the inference of cell lineages and communication networks.
the development of mathematical and computational methods to infer the structure and dynamics of biological systems from single-cell RNA-Seq data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the authors developed a novel method for single-cell data that can infer cell lineage, pseudotime and cell communication networks.
the SoptSC method is a useful and robust tool for inferring cell lineages, cell–cell communication and marker genes.

SoptSC is a novel computational framework that enables inference of cell lineage, pseudotime, marker gene identification, and cell–cell communication in single-cell transcriptomics data, with applications to embryonic development, regeneration, and hematological differentiation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SoptSC is an integrated approach for cell lineage and cell communication network inference, which is robust to the noise of single-cell transcriptomic data.

SoptSC is a general framework that can be applied to a wide range of single cell datasets to perform multiple tasks, such as cell lineage inference, cell–cell communication network reconstruction, and cell state prediction, in a coherent manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inference of cell lineages and the cell–cell communication network can be performed in an integrated fashion using a single optimization problem.
a structured similarity matrix, in which cell-to-cell similarity is defined based on a set of features, can be used as a mathematical framework for inferring various aspects of single-cell data.
the inference of cell lineage and cell communication can be achieved simultaneously, with the former providing the framework for the latter.
